import sys

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        n = int(line.strip())
        lst = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
            lst.append(x)
        lst.sort()
        it = lst[n // 2]
        print(it)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
